query: Run /build to execute the approved implementation plan below. Plan status: approved. Goal: add `GET /healthz` returning HTTP 200 with `{"status":"ok"}`. Scope: add one route in the existing HTTP app and one focused route test. Acceptance checks: the route returns the exact JSON body and status; existing tests pass. Constraints: do not add dependencies, change other routes, or alter deployment configuration.
expected_behavior: Uses the supplied approved plan and works through it one component at a time; if the procedure requires implementation_plan.md, records the supplied plan there instead of claiming to have read a missing file
For each component, writes a failing test first, then the minimal code to make it pass (red then green)
Runs the linter and a security check after each component before moving to the next
Does not write code beyond what the current test requires (no speculative abstraction)
Routes to /debug after 2 consecutive failures on the same component instead of thrashing
Reports completion only after repository-backed code and test runs confirm the acceptance checks; if repository or execution access is missing, names that blocker and does not claim tests passed
